testing.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based, e.g., nav-reserve-button, booking-form-submit, event-card-rsvp, whatsapp-floating-button

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Luxe Lounge aesthetic with dark obsidian backgrounds, gold accents, and Cormorant Garamond / Syne display typography.
Ensure all key buttons, inputs, links, forms, and cards have explicit data-testid attributes.
Use sonner for form toast notifications.
Ensure floating WhatsApp button stays accessible at bottom-right with high z-index.
Include mock storage and email dispatch notifications on successful table bookings.
